tasks.title: Fix Mobile Responsive Design Issues
tasks.description:
Review and fix any remaining mobile responsive design issues in the calculator application:

1. Read existing CSS files:
   - src/components/Calculator.css
   - src/components/Button.css
   - src/components/Display.css

2. Review the existing responsive implementation and identify any issues:
   - Check media queries for mobile breakpoints (max-width: 480px, max-width: 768px)
   - Verify font sizes, padding, button sizing on small screens
   - Ensure the calculator fits properly on devices as small as 320px wide

3. Fix any identified issues:
   - Adjust media queries if needed
   - Fix any overflow or layout issues
   - Ensure touch targets are appropriately sized (min 44x44px)

4. Update or write tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to verify responsive behavior

5. Take screenshots using Playwright to verify the fixes work on multiple device sizes:
   - iPhone SE (375x667)
   - Pixel 5 (393x851)
   - iPad (768x1024)
   - Desktop (1920x1080)

Save screenshots to .eunomia/screenshots/developer/
acceptance_criteria: Calculator displays correctly on screens 320px wide and larger
All buttons are properly sized and accessible on mobile
No horizontal scrolling on mobile devices
Text is readable on all screen sizes

tasks.title: Validate Mobile Responsiveness
tasks.description:
Validate that the calculator is fully responsive on mobile devices:

1. Run the test suite:
   - Execute: npm test
   - Verify all tests pass, especially responsive tests in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx

2. Run visual validation using Playwright:
   - Use playwright-responsive-test.js if it exists, or create a similar script
   - Test on multiple device sizes: iPhone SE (375x667), Pixel 5 (393x851), iPad (768x1024)
   - Verify no layout issues, overflow, or broken UI elements

3. Take screenshots for QA review and save to .eunomia/screenshots/qa/

4. Verify acceptance criteria:
   - Calculator works on screens 320px and wider
   - No horizontal scrolling
   - Buttons are properly sized
   - Text is readable
acceptance_criteria: Visual validation shows proper layout on all device sizes
Calculator is usable on mobile devices
